historical_baseline: All 32 Task35 episodes and six frozen checkpoints. These opened data are diagnostic benchmarks, never fresh confirmation or model selection.

domain.synapses: four canonical stochastic EMS synapses; events and RNG explicit; future realized teacher release never model input
domain.scope: Existing local cylindrical compartment and four Task35 conductance panels. Clamp-conditioned states below are controlled state interventions, not claims about their natural frequency in physiology.

cc01_contract.state: V_mV, cai_mM, 18 ion gates, synaptic receptor/plasticity/event cursor/RNG state. A future compact model must declare the causal replacement for each retained or removed variable.
cc01_contract.inputs: injected current density, physical parameters, presynaptic events available at their causal time, explicit random draws or RNG state. Trial-V interface for later composition is tested in CC-17.
cc01_contract.initialization: Initial physical state encoder permitted only at initialization; alternatively causal warmup. No teacher state resets during autonomous evaluation.
cc01_contract.units: V mV; time ms; cai mM; current density mA/cm2; gbar S/cm2; synaptic conductance uS; area um2. Positive ionic/synaptic current is outward; injected current positive inward.
cc01_contract.behavioral_policy: Adaptation/recovery/frequency and stochastic-distribution specifications require dedicated support and preregistration before N4; this phase cannot certify them. No unconditional promotion of an architecture from N1.
cc01_contract.split_policy: Group whole episodes and conditioning families; no adjacent-window leakage. Fit/development/sealed separated; old Task35 data diagnostic only. New sealed episodes generated only after candidate freeze in CC-19.
cc01_contract.speed_policy: At least 10% paired median wall latency reduction with paired bootstrap lower 95% bound >0 against symmetric optimized formula and frozen hybrid baselines at registered workload in CC-18/19. N1 only diagnoses cost; no speed promotion.

native.timing_scope: Python-observed 40ms native episode including setup, events, RNG and probes, separately shadow replay. CPU baseline, not like-for-like GPU speedup. Compilation excluded.

memory.conditioning: Exact constant-voltage/constant-calcium gate evolution from equilibrium at -65mV, then common -65mV tail. At release V and Ca are set identically, synapses zero, physical parameters and future current matched. These are explicit state interventions, not an autonomous physiological-preparation claim.
memory.window_contrast: For tail >= window, all visible V/Ca samples in that recent window are exactly identical. Compare future spread of different conditioning histories. Half maximum endpoint separation is a minimax lower bound for any deterministic predictor using only that identical view.
memory.summary_contrast: A causal summary containing preparation V, duration and tail distinguishes histories; exact analytical reconstruction from that summary is a privileged diagnostic, not a compact learned deploy model.
memory.native_anchor: Eight extreme-history cases: preparation -85/-25mV for 200ms; tails 0/40ms; canonical panel; future current 0/0.006mA/cm2. Native initial gates imported as explicit interventions; full 10ms continuations checked.
memory.absence_policy: No detected collision does not prove sufficiency. No universal minimum latent dimension inferred. Persistence at longest tail yields only a lower-bound challenge in tested histories.

gpu.scope: Resident full membrane core: gates, ionic currents, Ca/SK update, semiimplicit voltage with NMDA, 18 gates/V/Ca outputs. Four causal synaptic base conductances supplied by independently audited shadow; receptor/plasticity/RNG generation excluded from resident-core timing and reported separately as host work. Three frozen models vectorized, formula replicated for fairness; latency per ensemble and normalized compartment-step reported. No total end-to-end GPU speed claim.
gpu.compile_failure_policy: Record compile failure and eager timing explicitly; no compiled speed conclusion, N1 cost gate incomplete; preserve memory diagnostics and downloadable artifacts.

decision: N1 is complete only when provenance, native/formula anchors, GPU numerical equivalence, timing scope, duplicate controls and view-identity checks pass and each CC task has an explicit conclusion. Finding collisions is an informative result, not technical failure. Compilation/numerical failures preserve diagnostics and block the cost gate. N2 preparation can be recommended only with a declared sufficient operational state/warmup candidate, not a proved minimum dimension. No learned model is trained or promoted; Task36 remains deferred.
budget: No optimizer training. 288 analytic memory continuations (72 conditioned states x2 panels x2 currents), eight native anchors, eight native full-synapse cases plus three timed canonical repeats, and three GPU batch sizes x3 arms. Stop on source/native-floor failure before GPU model judgment; collect scientific diagnostics even when no collisions exceed thresholds.
